Theyfailure moment
Had a panic attack while trying to make a casserole. The kitchen was dirty and the trash bin was full, and I didn't have an ingredient I thought I had, and someone asked me to do something else while I was trying to cook, and my boss was like three days late on paying me this month so I was stressed from that, and I saw my ugly dumbass face reflected in a pot.

All of that just piled on and I couldn't handle it and I just ended up freaking out and crying. The casserole turned out awful and barely edible.

I hate how sensitive I am to dumb, meaningless shit that shouldn't matter to normal people. I wish I was at least a prett girlfailure or cute boyfailure rather than having my ugly dysphoric body too. Fuck my life.
